rubrics.justification: Generally identifies a blastocyst with plausible good ICM/TE and notes the grading inconsistency, but the image appears somewhat collapsed/poorly expanded and does not clearly support a confident AA-level TE assessment.
Thoroughly integrates age, smoking, BMI, PCOS, ovarian reserve, semen quality, endometrium, and first-cycle status with embryo morphology and prognosis.

Reasoning is logical and well structured, especially around age-related aneuploidy limiting prognosis despite good morphology; only minor tension comes from calling the embryo high-grade while acknowledging image-stage ambiguity.

Recommendations are broadly consistent with IVF practice and correctly note Gardner stage definitions, SET preference, smoking cessation, and cautious discussion of PGT-A; slight overreach in some ancillary suggestions keeps it from perfect alignment.

Provides clear practical next steps for transfer and future cycles, including SET, luteal support review, smoking cessation, and contingency planning, though some advice remains somewhat general rather than case-operationalized.
